children: Solv Protocol plans to release 159.32 million SOLV in a supply unlock scheduled for May 2027. The tokens are allocated to ecosystem, investor and team wallets, and the release equals 2.70% of circulating supply.
The unlock removes the transfer restriction on these holdings. Investors and team members can then offer previously locked tokens for sale, adding to the amount of SOLV that could reach the market.

title: Solv Protocol: Unlocks 159.32 Million SOLV - May 2027
